entry.name: deviceAddress
entry.label: Bluetooth address of the device to control

entry.name: deviceName
entry.label: Last known name of the device, shown while it is unavailable

entry.name: deviceIcon
entry.label: Last known icon of the device, shown while it is unavailable

entry.name: icon
entry.label: Custom icon. Empty means use the device's own icon

entry.name: batteryDisplay
entry.label: How to show the battery percentage in the panel: 0 hidden, 1 badge on the icon, 2 next to the icon. -1 means not set yet, use showBattery

entry.name: showBattery
entry.label: Old on/off setting from before batteryDisplay existed. Only read when batteryDisplay is -1

entry.name: lowBatteryLevel
entry.label: Battery percentage at or below which the panel shows it in red

entry.name: leftClickAction
entry.label: What a left click does: connection (connect or disconnect), bluetooth (turn Bluetooth on or off), settings (open Bluetooth settings) or none

entry.name: middleClickAction
entry.label: What a middle click does, with the same values as leftClickAction

entry.name: powerOnAdapter
entry.label: Turn Bluetooth on when connecting while it is off

entry.name: notifyOnError
entry.label: Show a notification when connecting or disconnecting fails

entry.name: notifyOnCharge
entry.label: Show a notification when the battery is charged to chargeThreshold

entry.name: chargeThreshold
entry.label: Battery percentage to notify at while charging

entry.name: chargeResetBelow
entry.label: Notify again only after the battery dropped below this percentage
